marketing.hero_subtitle: Share your code. Your friend gets a welcome discount, and you earn credit on their first order.

marketing.punctual_promise_body: If your order arrives late, we’ll send a make-up coupon straight to your wallet — automatically.
marketing.punctual_coupon_body: The coupon value scales with how late your order is and is added to your wallet the moment it’s confirmed late.
marketing.punctual_step1_body: Look for the on-time badge on shops and at checkout — your order is covered automatically, no opt-in needed.
marketing.punctual_step2_body: From the moment you pay, Hero watches the estimated arrival time against the real delivery progress.
marketing.punctual_step3_body: If delivery runs past the guaranteed time, a make-up coupon lands in your wallet — no claim, no waiting.
marketing.punctual_faq1_a: Any order from a shop showing the on-time badge. The badge also appears on the checkout page so you know before you pay.
marketing.punctual_faq2_q: How much is the late coupon?
marketing.punctual_faq2_a: The coupon value scales with how late your order is, up to the cap shown in the full rules. It is added to your wallet automatically.
marketing.punctual_faq3_a: As soon as the order is marked delivered and confirmed late — usually within minutes. Check Wallet › Coupons.
marketing.punctual_faq4_a: Delays caused by extreme weather, incorrect addresses, or a failed first delivery attempt are not covered. See the full rules for details.

support.msg_about_ten: About 10 minutes — there's a little traffic.
support.faq_where_order_a: Open the order from the Orders tab to see live tracking on the map, your rider, and the estimated arrival time. If the rider has not moved for a while, tap "Contact support" below and we will check on it for you.
support.faq_refund_q: How do I request a refund?
support.faq_refund_a: Go to Orders, open the affected order, then choose "Request a refund". Pick the items and the reason, and add a photo if an item arrived damaged. Approved refunds return to your original payment method within 3–5 business days.
support.faq_missing_a: We are sorry about that. Open the order, tap "Get help with this order", and report the missing items. Most missing-item reports are refunded automatically once confirmed with the store.
support.faq_address_q: How do I change my delivery address?
support.faq_address_a: You can edit your address before the rider picks up the order from the order screen. After pickup the address is locked — contact support and we will try to reach the rider on your behalf.
support.faq_cancel_q: How do I cancel an order?
support.faq_cancel_a: Orders can be cancelled for free while the store is still confirming them. Once the store starts preparing your food, a cancellation may be partially charged. Open the order to see if cancellation is still available.
support.faq_payment_a: Coupons are applied automatically at checkout when your cart meets the minimum. If a coupon did not apply, check its expiry and minimum spend. For double charges or failed payments, contact support with your order number and we will resolve it.
support.faq_fees_a: Delivery fees depend on the store distance and current demand. Stores marked "Free delivery" waive the fee when your order meets their minimum. The exact fee is always shown before you place the order.
support.faq_contact_rider_q: How do I contact the rider?
support.faq_contact_rider_a: After a rider is assigned, open the live-tracking screen and use the call or chat buttons on the rider bar. Please keep messages about the delivery only.
